state update / tool result: recheck from O2
G3 Agent graph v0.7 (BUILT 2026-11-05). Wave 4: document versions, household policies and balance claims, caregiver authority, grievance and Ombudsman.
Every turn: START -> M1 -> O1 -> O2 -> C1 -> (P1) -> turn route. Button -> X1 -> C1 -> END. Typed text -> I1 -> A1 or R1. Uploads and tool results -> A1.
Colours: blue = model, grey = deterministic Python, teal = new this step, orange = human pause, green = tools, yellow = API and external. Dashed = run ends.
messages; documents [{id, doc_type, status, facts, source}]
connection {case_id, status} (case id never leaves the server)
notifications [{id, kind, text, read}]; requested_action; intent
v0.7: authority {basis, proof, scope, expiry, status}; audit [...]
v0.7: dispute {...}; claims_history; claim_info.policy_doc_id, round, balance_of
required docs; names and dates agree; policy period, totals
query: item already provided; answered query ends it
P1: bank credit by UTR or amount, short or missing payment
late or overdue flags; stage payment_reported / _mismatch / _verified
v0.7: version choice pending; 2+ covering policies and none chosen;
authority withdrawn, expired or not covering submission (all block)
O1: same type again -> replace or keep both; the same bytes again are refused
X1: replace/keep (approval reset), choose policy, balance claim (archives the
first insurer's letters, encloses them, claims the rest), grievance and
Ombudsman letters from decision facts (PAUSE: approve), dates recorded
Authority: proof checked (grantor = patient, names match); withdrawal pauses
work and cancels approval; acting_user sent; the payer may still refuse
C1: reminders after uploads: grievance 14 days, authority expiry; a revised
decision reopens only the decision and payment check; audit log of changes
